HOW TO PLAY

  • Steer with the left pads or tilt your phone.
  • Gas on the right. Tap DRIFT while turning to slide.
  • Drifting and near misses charge N2O and multiply your score.
  • Blast through checkpoints to add time. The clock never stops.
  • Desktop: WASD / arrows, Space to drift, Shift for boost.
